tr.title: delulu ne demek?
tr.metaDesc: delulu ne demek? Gen Z argosu, “delusional” kısaltması. Anlamı, örnek cümleler ve kalıplar — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: delulu, “delusional” (hayalperest) kelimesinin Gen Z kısaltması. Gerçekçi olmayan, kafasında kurduğu hayale inanan kişi için kullanılır — genelde şakacı, sevimli bir tonla.

means.def: Hayalperest, gerçeklikten kopuk (sevimli/şakacı)
means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.
means.t: O kadar hayalperest ki, ona geri yazacağını sanıyor.

means.def: Kendi hayaline aşırı inanan (motivasyon olarak da)
means.en: Stay delulu, it keeps you motivated.

en.title: What does delulu mean?
en.metaDesc: What does delulu mean? Gen Z slang short for “delusional”. Meaning, examples and phrases — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: delulu is Gen Z slang, a shortening of “delusional”. It describes someone unrealistically optimistic or lost in their own fantasy — usually said playfully.

means.def: Unrealistic, out of touch with reality (playful)
means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

means.def: Over-believing in your own dream (as motivation)
means.en: Stay delulu, it keeps you motivated.

de.title: Was bedeutet delulu?
de.metaDesc: Was bedeutet delulu? Gen-Z-Slang, Kurzform von „delusional“. Bedeutung, Beispiele und Redewendungen — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: delulu ist Gen-Z-Slang, eine Kurzform von „delusional“ (wahnhaft). Es beschreibt jemanden, der unrealistisch optimistisch ist — meist scherzhaft gemeint.

means.def: Unrealistisch, realitätsfern (scherzhaft)
means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

means.def: Übermäßiger Glaube an den eigenen Traum (als Motivation)
means.en: Stay delulu, it keeps you motivated.

fr.lede: delulu est de l'argot Gen Z, une abréviation de « delusional » (délirant). Décrit quelqu'un d'irréaliste ou perdu dans son fantasme — souvent dit avec humour.

means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

es.lede: delulu es jerga de la Generación Z, abreviatura de «delusional» (delirante). Describe a alguien poco realista o perdido en su fantasía — normalmente con tono de broma.

means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

pt.title: O que significa delulu?

pt.lede: delulu é gíria da Geração Z, abreviação de «delusional» (iludido). Descreve alguém irrealista ou perdido na própria fantasia — normalmente em tom de brincadeira.

means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

means.en: She's so delulu, she thinks he'll text back.

means.def: 自分の夢を信じすぎる（モチベーションとして）
